answer: A storage trellis assigns identity k in one funding cluster k sealed 512-MiB shards for 30 days, so aliases 1, 2, and 3 retain 512, 1,024, and 1,536 MiB separately. Reused shards or missing proofs link the cluster, burn 85% of every bond, and bar all keys for 60 days. Thus each extra Sybil adds irreversible storage, bandwidth, and collateral that auditors can verify and punish.
